title: Trade Phase 3 - Execution Efficiency Research

sell_rebuy_chain_attribution.low_value_definition: Ex-post diagnostic only: a pure account_budget_trim sell bucket, followed by the next same-symbol buy within the already-retained 20-session churn horizon, where modeled direct costs plus reacquisition price effect exceed observed interim downside avoided on matched shares.

preserve_strategy_or_mixed.decision: Preserve: these chains include strategy/mixed/hard-risk reasons and are not valid removal candidates from this diagnostic.

order_fragmentation.interpretation: Internal sleeve accounting is highly fragmented relative to date-symbol-side actions, but these are not verified broker orders. This research does not authorize changing sleeve accounting or execution semantics.

partial_adjustments.interpretation: Small adjustment size alone is not a valid suppression rule: the smallest observed reduction overall was a strategy exit, not AB5.

supported_findings: A material subset of current short-horizon churn is concentrated in pure AB5 reductions: 25 of 40 retained <=20-session re-entry chains satisfy the strict ex-post low-value definition.
Those 25 chains have about 0.933 million of modeled net chain drag, dominated by reacquisition at higher prices rather than explicit transaction cost alone.
Twelve of those 25 chains never traded below the original sell price before the next buy, which is strong descriptive evidence of unnecessary exposure interruption in those historical cases.
Not all short-horizon AB5 churn is wasteful: two pure-AB5 short chains show observed protection large enough to offset modeled execution/reacquisition drag.
Internal fill fragmentation is substantial, but date-symbol-side consolidation is an operational representation issue unless internal accounting and all frozen execution semantics remain exact.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not suppress all AB5 trims that would later be rebought; future re-entry is unavailable at decision time and would leak future information.
Do not suppress all small reductions; small size is not equivalent to low risk value.
Do not collapse internal sleeve fills merely to reduce the reported transaction count; 645 is not a verified broker-order count and accounting semantics are frozen.
phase_decision.next_research_target: If a production improvement is pursued, derive a close-known AB5 re-risk/hysteresis or exposure-ownership signal that predicts the historical low-value churn cohort while preserving the protective cohort, then validate it causally against the unchanged risk/golden contracts.

evidence_identity.python312_result: 1 intentional research receipt failure; 1278 other tests and 318 subtests passed

limitations: Low-value chain classification is retrospective and uses future rebuy/interim prices. It is evidence for mechanism discovery only, never a production decision rule.
Modeled downside avoided is a matched-share path attribution and is not a complete counterfactual risk guarantee.
A same-symbol future buy may belong to a different strategy/sleeve; symbol-level chaining intentionally measures economic reacquisition while retaining sell reasons for interpretation.
Internal sleeve fills and date-symbol-side buckets must not be represented as verified broker orders.
